info.title: @mintopia/harmonic
info.description:
Queue, run, and review autonomous coding-agent tasks over ACP

## MCP

`POST /mcp` is a stateless streamable-HTTP MCP server (not a REST
endpoint, so it has no entry in this spec's paths). It authenticates the
same way as the REST API — a bearer token, either an operator API key or
the Attempt Key Harmonic injects into a spawned harness — and exposes the
agent task surface as MCP tools (task CRUD, dependencies, queue/cancel,
attempts and events). Accept/Retry are human-only and are never exposed as
MCP tools — a verifier's pass is the accept (#140, ADR-0021). An attempt-scoped
Attempt Key may call `/mcp` regardless of the REST restrictions noted per
endpoint below.

## WebSocket

`GET /api/ws` is a single firehose WebSocket (also outside this spec's
paths): every attempt event, attempt state change, task state change/removal, and
Conversation event/change is broadcast to every connected client as JSON
messages of the form `{ type: 'attempt_event' | 'attempt_changed' | 'attempt_timeline_changed' |
'attempt_usage' | 'task_changed' | 'task_removed' | 'epic_changed' | 'epic_integrated' |
'agent_messages_changed' | 'scheduled-jobs' | 'operations' | 'worktrees' | 'host_load' |
'export_failed' | 'notification_created' | 'notifications_read' | 'fs_changed' | 'git_status' |
'attempt_log_event' | 'critic_log_event' | 'heartbeat' | 'conversation_event' |
'conversation_changed' | 'conversation_commands' | 'permission_request' |
'elicitation_request', ... }`, using the same Task/Attempt/Conversation/Scheduled Job/Operation shapes
served over REST. `attempt_usage` is a live-usage snapshot for a running Attempt
(tokens, context fill, derived Cost, current-activity line, and Process
Tree), pushed about once a second while the Attempt tails its native log.
`task_removed` (issue #162) announces a hard-deleted Task's id (`{ type:
'task_removed', id }`) — the row is gone, not another state change.
`scheduled-jobs` announces the full Scheduled Job registry snapshot, matching
`GET /api/scheduled-jobs`.
`operations` announces an Operation lifecycle event, matching the operation shape
served by `GET /api/operations`.
`permission_request` announces a Harness blocked on an
operator permission decision in a Conversation (ADR-0007), answered via
`POST /conversations/:id/permissions/:reqId`. Authenticate by offering the
session token or an API key as the sole WebSocket subprotocol
(`new WebSocket(url, [token])`) — never as a query parameter, which leaks
into logs and browser history. A browser client authenticated by session
cookie needs no subprotocol. A `read`-scoped key gets the firehose minus the Conversation and permission
traffic (`conversation_event`, `conversation_changed`, `conversation_commands`,
`permission_request`, `elicitation_request`); everything else, including
`attempt_timeline_changed` and the `epic_*` events, is delivered. The server
sends a protocol ping and a `{ type: 'heartbeat', intervalMs, ts }` message every
30 seconds (browsers cannot see protocol pings); a client that sees nothing for
two intervals can treat the connection as dead and reconnect. A connection that
misses a pong is terminated. Cross-origin REST calls are allowed for origins
listed in `HARMONIC_CORS_ORIGINS` (comma-separated, `*` for any); credentials
are never allowed, so authenticate with a bearer key.

## Read scope

A `read`-scoped API key (created via `POST /api/keys` with
`{ "scope": "read" }`) is a viz-client credential: it may `GET` Workspaces and their Epics (`/api/workspaces/:id/epics[/:ref]`), tasks, attempts, the WebSocket (`/api/ws`, filtered as above), Workspaces (`/api/workspaces`), maps, the instance-wide Activity snapshot (`/api/activity`, filtered to Attempts only for a read key), Operations (`/api/operations`), Scheduled Jobs (`/api/scheduled-jobs`), Notifications (`/api/notifications`). Every mutation and the whole operator surface (keys, config,
channels, Conversations) is blocked. There is no `map_changed` event — a
client re-fetches `/maps` on reconnect or when it sees a `mapRef` it has
not resolved yet.

post.description: Resume a paused task. `continuation` picks how it re-attaches to its prior Session: `full` reuses the retained conversation, `condensed` starts a fresh one; omitted keeps the recommended default. Key scopes: full, attempt.

200.description: The working task.

409.description: The task is not paused.

post.description: Force a working task to done (operator override): stop the agent and settle it done, skipping verification and merging. Operator only: reachable with a full-scope key or session, not an attempt-scoped Attempt Key or a Read Key.

200.description: The task in its new state.

409.description: The task is not working.

post.description: Steer a running task: send an operator message to its active Attempt. When the harness supports ACP mid-turn steering, the message is injected into the running turn immediately — pre-empting the current generation without cancelling it. Otherwise, or when the agent is parked between turns, the message is queued and delivered as a fresh prompt turn at the next turn boundary. When no Attempt is active but the task's last Attempt left a resumable session (an escalated task that ended without closure), the message continues that session in a fresh Attempt. A paused task is resumed to working and the message delivered the same way; a working task whose Attempt is no longer running (restarted, upgraded, or torn down between turns) is relaunched. A resume is never refused: a cold cache only changes the estimated cost, and a Session incompatible for continue-full (harness/adapter-version/cwd/permission-mode changed) falls back to start-condensed rather than blocking. Use it to redirect an agent that has gone off-track, nudge one that ended its turn and parked, continue one whose Attempt just ended, resume a paused one, or relaunch a stranded one. Operator only: reachable with a full-scope key or session, not an attempt-scoped Attempt Key or a Read Key.

text.example: Stop — check the existing tests before changing the limiter.

200.description: The message was injected into the running turn or queued at the next boundary of the task's active Attempt, continued its last Attempt's resumable session in a fresh Attempt, resumed a paused task and delivered the message, or relaunched a stranded working task.

409.description: The task is in a state that cannot be steered (draft, ready, done, or cancelled).

post.description: Extend the wall-clock time guardrail of a working task's live Attempt by `minutes`, giving a run that is close to its budget more time without restarting it. The raised cap is persisted onto the Attempt's frozen guardrail config and the live deadline is re-armed immediately. Key scopes: full, attempt.

200.description: The working task, with the extended budget in effect.

409.description: The task is not working or has no active Attempt with a wall-clock budget.

post.description: Return a cancelled task to the queue in place (ready; blocked-ness is derived from its open blockers). Key scopes: full, attempt.

200.description: The task in its new state.

409.description: The task is not cancelled.

post.description: Add a dependency edge, re-deriving the open-blocker count. Key scopes: full, attempt.

200.description: The task with the edge added, and its open-blocker count re-derived.

409.description: The edge is unknown, self-referential, or would close a dependency cycle.

delete.description: Remove a dependency edge, re-deriving the open-blocker count. Key scopes: full, attempt.

200.description: The task with the edge removed, and its open-blocker count re-derived.

post.description: Accept an escalated ticket: the operator has judged the work done, so the candidate is merged as-is — merge, close the tracker issue, clean up, move it to done — with no verification. Human-only. Operator only: reachable with a full-scope key or session, not an attempt-scoped Attempt Key or a Read Key.

200.description: The task, now done and merged.

409.description: The task is not escalated, has no candidate to accept (the branch has no commits ahead of its base), or the merging failed (the detail says why); it stays escalated.

post.description: Retry an escalated ticket: optional guidance becomes feedback for the next Attempt and the attempt budget resets. `harness`/`model` save both as operator settings on the Ticket, which outrank its Routing Label. The ticket requeues to `ready` — the Auto-Runner starts the next Attempt when capacity frees; with `startNow` it starts immediately, bypassing the capacity ceiling, on a fresh Session unless `reuseSession` re-uses the prior one (400 when the Harness changed or `startNow` is not set). The escalated Attempt's branch is retained as evidence until its Session retires. Human-only. Operator only: reachable with a full-scope key or session, not an attempt-scoped Attempt Key or a Read Key.

guidance.example: The limiter is per-process; it needs to be shared across workers.

200.description: The task, back in the Attempt loop.

400.description: Session re-use was requested without `startNow` or with a changed Harness.

409.description: The task is not escalated.

post.description: Close an escalated ticket: cancel it and clean up — remove its branch and worktree, close the tracker issue. Human-only. Operator only: reachable with a full-scope key or session, not an attempt-scoped Attempt Key or a Read Key.

200.description: The task, cancelled.

409.description: The task is not escalated.

get.description: Stream a command verification attempt's full, uncapped output from the Archive (text/plain). 404 when the attempt's output was not truncated or the Archive no longer holds it. Operator only: reachable with a full-scope key or session, not an attempt-scoped Attempt Key or a Read Key.

200.description: The full combined stdout+stderr of the verify command.

schema.description: The full combined stdout+stderr of the verify command.

404.description: No such verification attempt, or no archived full output.

get.description: Read a Resolved Prompt from the Task Archive by its Attempt-relative locator (e.g. `verification/pre-merge/<stepId>/prompt.md` or `implementation/prompt.md`), as text/plain. The file is read on demand off the event loop; nothing is stored in the database. With `segments=true` it returns JSON `{ prompts }`, one string per turn, sliced from the step's offset index so prompts containing horizontal rules stay whole (archives written before the index existed fall back to splitting on the separator). 404 when the Attempt or the archived prompt is absent. Key scopes: full, attempt, read.

parameters.name: locator
parameters.description: Archive locator of the prompt file, relative to the Attempt directory.

parameters.name: segments
parameters.description: When `true`, return the prompts of the step as a JSON array instead of the joined text.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: 0-based index of one prompt within the file; omit to return the whole file. Cannot be combined with `segments=true`.

200.description: Plain text: the archived prompt exactly as sent (only the `index`-th prompt when `index` is given); multiple prompts joined by a horizontal rule. With `segments=true`: JSON `{ prompts: string[] }`, one entry per prompt sent.

schema.description: Plain text: the archived prompt exactly as sent (only the `index`-th prompt when `index` is given); multiple prompts joined by a horizontal rule. With `segments=true`: JSON `{ prompts: string[] }`, one entry per prompt sent.

404.description: No such Attempt, or no archived Resolved Prompt at the locator.

Key scopes: full, attempt, read.

post.description: Export again: rebuild the Export and deliver it to every configured Destination regardless of the includeStates filter, as a new Export that never overwrites an earlier one. A Task that predates the Archive is built from surviving records and flagged `partial`. Only done or cancelled Tasks; 409 when the Task is not finished or no Destination is enabled. Key scopes: full, attempt.

Operator only: reachable with a full-scope key or session, not an attempt-scoped Attempt Key or a Read Key.

post.description: Set or change the operator password. When one is already set, currentPassword must match (a wrong current password changes nothing); when none is set (ungated), currentPassword is ignored and this sets the initial password. newPassword takes the same minimum-length rule as initial setup. On success every session other than the caller's own is destroyed — a stolen cookie doesn't survive a credential rotation — but API Keys are untouched. Operator only: reachable with a full-scope key or session, not an attempt-scoped Attempt Key or a Read Key.

get.description: Instance-wide snapshot of every capacity-consuming Attempt and warm Conversation across Workspaces (ADR 0010). Attempts come from persisted state and join their latest live Usage, context fill, derived Cost, current-activity line, and Process Tree when available. A Read Key (a read-scoped API key) sees Attempts only — Conversations are excluded, matching the firehose filter. Key scopes: full, read.

201.description: The created channel; events falls back to the default subscriptions when omitted.

400.description: The payload failed validation, or the config does not match the shape the channel's type requires.

get.description: List notification channels. Operator only: reachable with a full-scope key or session, not an attempt-scoped Attempt Key or a Read Key.

200.description: Every configured notification channel.

schema.description: Every configured notification channel.

get.description: Get one notification channel. Operator only: reachable with a full-scope key or session, not an attempt-scoped Attempt Key or a Read Key.

200.description: The channel, with its delivery config and subscriptions.

patch.description: Edit a notification channel. Operator only: reachable with a full-scope key or session, not an attempt-scoped Attempt Key or a Read Key.

200.description: The updated channel.

400.description: The payload failed validation, or the config does not match the shape the channel's existing type requires.

delete.description: Delete a notification channel. Operator only: reachable with a full-scope key or session, not an attempt-scoped Attempt Key or a Read Key.

200.description: The channel was deleted, along with every per-task override pointing at it.

post.description: Add a per-task channel override: this task announces its events to this channel in addition to the channel's own subscriptions. Operator only: reachable with a full-scope key or session, not an attempt-scoped Attempt Key or a Read Key.

200.description: Every channel id now overridden for the task; adding an override that is already set changes nothing.

schema.description: Every channel id now overridden for the task; adding an override that is already set changes nothing.

get.description: List a task's per-task channel overrides. Operator only: reachable with a full-scope key or session, not an attempt-scoped Attempt Key or a Read Key.

200.description: The channel ids overridden for the task, empty when it relies solely on the channels' own subscriptions.

schema.description: The channel ids overridden for the task, empty when it relies solely on the channels' own subscriptions.

delete.description: Remove a per-task channel override. Operator only: reachable with a full-scope key or session, not an attempt-scoped Attempt Key or a Read Key.

200.description: Every channel id still overridden for the task; removing an override that was not set is a no-op.

schema.description: Every channel id still overridden for the task; removing an override that was not set is a no-op.

get.description: List stored Notifications, newest first. `workspaceId` is the Workspace Scope; omitted means Global. `before` is an id cursor: pass the last id of the previous page. `unreadCount` respects the Workspace Scope only.  Key scopes: full, read.

200.description: One page of Notifications plus the unread count for the scope.

schema.description: One page of Notifications plus the unread count for the scope.

post.description: Mark every unread Notification in the scope read (all Workspaces when `workspaceId` is omitted). Operator only: reachable with a full-scope key or session, not an attempt-scoped Attempt Key or a Read Key.

200.description: How many Notifications changed.

schema.description: How many Notifications changed.

post.description: Mark one Notification read. Idempotent: the first read time is kept. Operator only: reachable with a full-scope key or session, not an attempt-scoped Attempt Key or a Read Key.

200.description: The Notification after the update.

schema.description: The Notification after the update.

get.description: Immediate child directories of `path`, one level deep — the data behind the workspace directory picker (issue #62). An empty or omitted `path` starts at the server user's home. Files and hidden (dot) directories are excluded; entries are sorted by name. No root restriction — any directory the running user can read is browsable (a sysadmin concern, per the map decision). Operator-only: a full-scope session is required. Operator only: reachable with a full-scope key or session, not an attempt-scoped Attempt Key or a Read Key.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Absolute path to browse; defaults to the server user home.

200.description: The browsed path, its parent, and its immediate child directories.

400.description: The path is not a directory, or the running user cannot read it.

get.description: A paginated directory listing confined to one Workspace working directory. Operator only: reachable with a full-scope key or session, not an attempt-scoped Attempt Key or a Read Key.

200.description: A page of workspace files and directories.

schema.description: A page of workspace files and directories.

400.description: Invalid path.

get.description: Read one text file confined to a Workspace working directory. Operator only: reachable with a full-scope key or session, not an attempt-scoped Attempt Key or a Read Key.

200.description: The requested workspace file and its metadata.

schema.description: The requested workspace file and its metadata.

400.description: Invalid path.

put.description: Operator-only: write one text file confined to a Workspace working directory. Operator only: reachable with a full-scope key or session, not an attempt-scoped Attempt Key or a Read Key.

200.description: The saved workspace file and its metadata.

schema.description: The saved workspace file and its metadata.

400.description: Invalid path or body.

get.description: Stream one file confined to a Workspace working directory. Operator only: reachable with a full-scope key or session, not an attempt-scoped Attempt Key or a Read Key.

400.description: Invalid path.

post.description: Operator-only: create an empty file or directory confined to a Workspace working directory. Operator only: reachable with a full-scope key or session, not an attempt-scoped Attempt Key or a Read Key.

200.description: The created entry.

schema.description: The created entry.

400.description: Invalid path, or an entry already exists there.

404.description: Workspace or parent directory not found.

post.description: Operator-only: rename or move a file or directory within a Workspace working directory. Operator only: reachable with a full-scope key or session, not an attempt-scoped Attempt Key or a Read Key.

200.description: The moved entry at its new path.

schema.description: The moved entry at its new path.

400.description: Invalid path, or the destination already exists.

post.description: Operator-only: delete a file or directory (recursively) within a Workspace working directory. Operator only: reachable with a full-scope key or session, not an attempt-scoped Attempt Key or a Read Key.

200.description: The entry is deleted.

schema.description: The entry is deleted.

400.description: Invalid path.

get.description: Read the Workspace Git status without changing its working directory or index. Operator only: reachable with a full-scope key or session, not an attempt-scoped Attempt Key or a Read Key.

200.description: Git status entries from porcelain v2 output.

schema.description: Git status entries from porcelain v2 output.

get.description: Unified diff of one working-directory path (staged + unstaged vs HEAD; an untracked file reads as all-added). Operator only: reachable with a full-scope key or session, not an attempt-scoped Attempt Key or a Read Key.

200.description: The parsed per-file diff, or null when there is no textual diff.

schema.description: The parsed per-file diff, or null when there is no textual diff.

400.description: Invalid path.

post.description: Stage selected paths in a Workspace Git repository. Operator only: reachable with a full-scope key or session, not an attempt-scoped Attempt Key or a Read Key.

200.description: The selected paths are staged.

schema.description: The selected paths are staged.

post.description: Unstage selected paths in a Workspace Git repository. Operator only: reachable with a full-scope key or session, not an attempt-scoped Attempt Key or a Read Key.

200.description: The selected paths are unstaged.

schema.description: The selected paths are unstaged.

post.description: Discard selected tracked or untracked paths in a Workspace Git repository. Operator only: reachable with a full-scope key or session, not an attempt-scoped Attempt Key or a Read Key.

200.description: The selected changes are discarded.

schema.description: The selected changes are discarded.

post.description: Commit the staged changes in a Workspace Git repository. Operator only: reachable with a full-scope key or session, not an attempt-scoped Attempt Key or a Read Key.

200.description: The staged changes are committed.

schema.description: The staged changes are committed.

post.description: Write then remove a probe file or object at an Export Destination. A destination failure is reported as ok:false, never a 5xx. Operator only: reachable with a full-scope key or session, not an attempt-scoped Attempt Key or a Read Key.

workspaceId.description: Workspace whose overrides apply; omit or null for the global config only.

200.description: The probe outcome.

error.example: NoSuchBucket: The specified bucket does not exist

schema.description: The probe outcome.

400.description: The destination is not configured, or the workspaceId is malformed.

get.description: Every open Epic for a Workspace (issue #167, ADR-0018) — an integrated Epic leaves this list and resolves by ref only — each folded with its member merge state, integration-branch tip, and whole-Epic integrate/verification state. Searched (`q`, case-insensitive substring over the Epic title) and paginated (`limit`/`offset`, with a `total`). Key scopes: full, read.

200.description: Every derived Epic for this Workspace's last scan (possibly empty).

schema.description: Every derived Epic for this Workspace's last scan (possibly empty).

get.description: One derived Epic by its tracker ref, from the Workspace's last poll scan (issue #167). 404s when the scan derives no leaf-most Epic with that ref. Key scopes: full, read.

200.description: The derived Epic.

404.description: No Workspace has that id, or its last scan derives no Epic with that ref.

get.description: Every durable Attempt owned by this Epic, ordered by its Epic-local timeline number. Operator only: reachable with a full-scope key or session, not an attempt-scoped Attempt Key or a Read Key.

200.description: The Epic Attempt timeline with durable usage and frozen cost.

get.description: Read an Epic's Resolved Prompt from the Task Archive by Attempt number and Attempt-relative locator, as text/plain. Serves prompts archived before the Epic had an Attempt row (under Attempt 1). 404 when the archived prompt is absent. Operator only: reachable with a full-scope key or session, not an attempt-scoped Attempt Key or a Read Key.

parameters.name: attempt
parameters.description: Epic-local Attempt number the prompt was archived under.

parameters.name: locator
parameters.description: Archive locator of the prompt file, relative to the Attempt directory.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: 0-based index of one prompt within the file; omit to return the whole file.

200.description: The archived prompt text exactly as sent, or only the `index`-th prompt when `index` is given.

schema.description: The archived prompt text exactly as sent, or only the `index`-th prompt when `index` is given.

404.description: No Workspace has that id, or no archived Resolved Prompt at the locator.

post.description: Retry an escalated Epic with guidance. The guidance is recorded on the escalated Epic Attempt and included in the next whole-Epic resolver turn. Operator only: reachable with a full-scope key or session, not an attempt-scoped Attempt Key or a Read Key.

guidance.example: Fix the failing integration test before trying again.

200.description: The outcome of retrying the Epic and requeuing it with operator guidance.

409.description: The Epic is not escalated or has no active whole-Epic coordinator.

get.description: Per-file unified-diff hunks for the whole-Epic diff panel (ADR-0018): what `epic/<ref>` changes over base while open, the frozen merge-commit diff once integrated (survives branch retirement). Paginated. Empty `files` for a branchless/no-op Epic. Operator only: reachable with a full-scope key or session, not an attempt-scoped Attempt Key or a Read Key.

200.description: The Epic's changed files with parsed +/- hunks; empty for a branchless/no-op Epic.

schema.description: The Epic's changed files with parsed +/- hunks; empty for a branchless/no-op Epic.
